description: This Java source file defines the class VcapServicesStringParser, which implements a Function to parse VCAP services configuration strings (JSON or HOCON) into a Config object. It handles parsing, validation, and conversion of config lists into flattened config objects, providing error handling for invalid formats.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringParser
classes.description: A singleton class implementing Function<String, Config> that parses VCAP services configuration strings into Config objects, handling JSON/HOCON formats, validation, and conversion of configs.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of VcapServicesStringParser.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Parses the provided VCAP services string into a Config object, returning an empty config if the string is empty.

methods.name: tryToParseString
methods.description: Attempts to parse the input string into a Config object, throwing a DittoConfigError if parsing fails.

methods.name: convertConfigListToConfigObject
methods.description: Converts a ConfigList into a flattened ConfigObject with string keys, used within parsing.

methods.name: getAsConfigObject
methods.description: Converts a ConfigList into a ConfigObject with flattened keys, taking into account nested objects.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' property from a ConfigObject, assuming it is used as an identifier.
